meta.description: A heart beats in the darkness, and inscribed upon it is sincerity.

units.rawText: Ahh...
units.displayText: Ahh...

units.rawText: That's the third one this month. If this continues, the Ops Room will turn into some sort of urban legend even scarier than haunted houses.

units.rawText: The mighty are often alone. You are of sufficient power, and mentally robust to match. I trust that you are able to enjoy this exclusive sort of loneliness, Professor.
units.displayText: The mighty are often alone. You are of sufficient power, and mentally robust to match. I trust that you are able to enjoy this exclusive sort of loneliness, Professor.

spans.text: The mighty are often alone. You are of sufficient power, and mentally robust to match. I trust that you are able to enjoy this exclusive sort of loneliness, Professor.

units.rawText: Then I would rather give up that strength, and get along with everyone at the Oasis.
units.displayText: Then I would rather give up that strength, and get along with everyone at the Oasis.

spans.text: Then I would rather give up that strength, and get along with everyone at the Oasis.

units.rawText: Professor... do you not wish for me to protect you?
units.displayText: Professor... do you not wish for me to protect you?

spans.text: Professor... do you not wish for me to protect you?

units.rawText: Penumbra lowers his head, and his curled hair almost appears to droop downwards.
units.displayText: Penumbra lowers his head, and his curled hair almost appears to droop downwards.

spans.text: Penumbra lowers his head, and his curled hair almost appears to droop downwards.

units.rawText: That's not what I meant... it's just that the Oasis is pretty safe now, and I have no need for such rigorous protection right now.
units.displayText: That's not what I meant... it's just that the Oasis is pretty safe now, and I have no need for such rigorous protection right now.

spans.text: That's not what I meant... it's just that the Oasis is pretty safe now, and I have no need for such rigorous protection right now.

units.rawText: If you stay with me the entire day, all you'll get to see is me doing dull repetitive work.
units.displayText: If you stay with me the entire day, all you'll get to see is me doing dull repetitive work.

spans.text: If you stay with me the entire day, all you'll get to see is me doing dull repetitive work.

units.rawText: You toil towards returning the Dolls in Project Neural Cloud to reality. That is not dull work.
units.displayText: You toil towards returning the Dolls in Project Neural Cloud to reality. That is not dull work.

spans.text: You toil towards returning the Dolls in Project Neural Cloud to reality. That is not dull work.

units.rawText: Even if you stay in my vicinity 24/7, I won't pay you for any overtime.
units.displayText: Even if you stay in my vicinity 24/7, I won't pay you for any overtime.

spans.text: Even if you stay in my vicinity 24/7, I won't pay you for any overtime.

units.rawText: You can even charge me for what I do, Professor. Protecting you and removing possible threats is my job.
units.displayText: You can even charge me for what I do, Professor. Protecting you and removing possible threats is my job.

spans.text: You can even charge me for what I do, Professor. Protecting you and removing possible threats is my job.

units.rawText: Penumbra... your job isn't all there is in life.
units.displayText: Penumbra... your job isn't all there is in life.

spans.text: Penumbra... your job isn't all there is in life.

units.rawText: Don't focus on me constantly. Go look at the sunset, listen to some music you like. Doesn't that sound better?
units.displayText: Don't focus on me constantly. Go look at the sunset, listen to some music you like. Doesn't that sound better?

spans.text: Don't focus on me constantly. Go look at the sunset, listen to some music you like. Doesn't that sound better?

units.rawText: Let your stifled emotions out with the music, feel the free spirit of nature.
units.displayText: Let your stifled emotions out with the music, feel the free spirit of nature.

spans.text: Let your stifled emotions out with the music, feel the free spirit of nature.

units.rawText: Instead of guarding me, I would rather have you find your own happiness and reason to exist.
units.displayText: Instead of guarding me, I would rather have you find your own happiness and reason to exist.

spans.text: Instead of guarding me, I would rather have you find your own happiness and reason to exist.

units.rawText: Reason to exist...
units.displayText: Reason to exist...

spans.text: Reason to exist...

units.rawText: ...Save for removing threats, I have no reason to exist.
units.displayText: ...Save for removing threats, I have no reason to exist.

spans.text: ...Save for removing threats, I have no reason to exist.

units.rawText: His voice lowers.
units.displayText: His voice lowers.

spans.text: His voice lowers.

units.rawText: You fished me out of the dregs.
units.displayText: You fished me out of the dregs.

spans.text: You fished me out of the dregs.

units.rawText: You should know that Penumbra is a simpleton who knows nothing other than assassination techniques, and will inevitably fail at anything else.
units.displayText: You should know that Penumbra is a simpleton who knows nothing other than assassination techniques, and will inevitably fail at anything else.

spans.text: You should know that Penumbra is a simpleton who knows nothing other than assassination techniques, and will inevitably fail at anything else.

units.rawText: The only task I can perform well is protecting you from whatever may harm you. Other than that, there is nothing I can do to repay you.
units.displayText: The only task I can perform well is protecting you from whatever may harm you. Other than that, there is nothing I can do to repay you.

spans.text: The only task I can perform well is protecting you from whatever may harm you. Other than that, there is nothing I can do to repay you.

units.rawText: Bringing back the members of Project Neural Cloud is nothing short of my duty. This is where you belong.
units.displayText: Bringing back the members of Project Neural Cloud is nothing short of my duty. This is where you belong.

spans.text: Bringing back the members of Project Neural Cloud is nothing short of my duty. This is where you belong.

units.rawText: For you to be happy is the greatest repayment I could ever ask for.
units.displayText: For you to be happy is the greatest repayment I could ever ask for.

spans.text: For you to be happy is the greatest repayment I could ever ask for.

units.rawText: Professor...
units.displayText: Professor...

spans.text: Professor...

units.rawText: How about that alternative work, then? Pay's better.
units.displayText: How about that alternative work, then? Pay's better.

spans.text: How about that alternative work, then? Pay's better.

units.displayText: Professor, you sound like the telecommunications scammers of the early 21st century.

units.displayText: Persicaria? What are you here for?

units.displayText: Some days ago at the concert, that magnesium lamp fell on your arm...

units.displayText: As Penumbra averts his head in shame, Persicaria refrains from continuing her recount.

units.rawText: Ah, that's what it was. She ran out crying, and I forgot to ask her what business she had entirely.

units.rawText: My most sincere apologies. Metal objects are not meant to be placed in a microwave, and the selected heating time was not adequate, resulting in an explosion.
units.displayText: My most sincere apologies. Metal objects are not meant to be placed in a microwave, and the selected heating time was not adequate, resulting in an explosion.

spans.text: My most sincere apologies. Metal objects are not meant to be placed in a microwave, and the selected heating time was not adequate, resulting in an explosion.

spans.text: You may deduct the necessary repair fees from my pay... Please keep your distance from that area. An explosion may be imminent.

units.rawText: ...The fault lies with me as well. I never considered that you had never used a microwave before...

spans.text: I can understand the cause and effect here, but... there are no organizations or individuals willing to hire Penumbra currently.

units.rawText: That...
units.displayText: That...

spans.text: That...

units.rawText: You look at the Doll behind you. Penumbra, previously quiet, fall into a deeper silence.
units.displayText: You look at the Doll behind you. Penumbra, previously quiet, fall into a deeper silence.

spans.text: You look at the Doll behind you. Penumbra, previously quiet, fall into a deeper silence.

units.rawText: ...Let's change the topic. There is another matter I wanted to discuss with you.
units.displayText: ...Let's change the topic. There is another matter I wanted to discuss with you.

spans.text: ...Let's change the topic. There is another matter I wanted to discuss with you.

units.rawText: The Administrator of Helios has sent a request for Dolls who can assist in post-warfare rebuilding.
units.displayText: The Administrator of Helios has sent a request for Dolls who can assist in post-warfare rebuilding.

spans.text: The Administrator of Helios has sent a request for Dolls who can assist in post-warfare rebuilding.

units.rawText: They are currently recruiting Dolls to head to the Sector. Uranus sent me a request to go.
units.displayText: They are currently recruiting Dolls to head to the Sector. Uranus sent me a request to go.

spans.text: They are currently recruiting Dolls to head to the Sector. Uranus sent me a request to go.

units.rawText: But his circumstances are... unique. It's best to ask him yourself. He's been waiting outside for some time. Let's hear it from him.
units.displayText: But his circumstances are... unique. It's best to ask him yourself. He's been waiting outside for some time. Let's hear it from him.

spans.text: But his circumstances are... unique. It's best to ask him yourself. He's been waiting outside for some time. Let's hear it from him.

units.rawText: Persicaria sends a message, and Uranus soon makes himself known via the Ops Room door. An old model of Doll covered in garish colors walks in, his magnetic voice ringing.
units.displayText: Persicaria sends a message, and Uranus soon makes himself known via the Ops Room door. An old model of Doll covered in garish colors walks in, his magnetic voice ringing.

spans.text: Persicaria sends a message, and Uranus soon makes himself known via the Ops Room door. An old model of Doll covered in garish colors walks in, his magnetic voice ringing.

units.rawText: Hello, Commander. My sincerest greetings to you.
units.displayText: Hello, Commander. My sincerest greetings to you.

spans.text: Hello, Commander. My sincerest greetings to you.

units.rawText: Persicaria should have told you of my request. Due to the Entropic assault, Helios' infrastructure is in ruins, and they are in trying times indeed as they undertake rebuilding operations.
units.displayText: Persicaria should have told you of my request. Due to the Entropic assault, Helios' infrastructure is in ruins, and they are in trying times indeed as they undertake rebuilding operations.

spans.text: Persicaria should have told you of my request. Due to the Entropic assault, Helios' infrastructure is in ruins, and they are in trying times indeed as they undertake rebuilding operations.

units.rawText: Helios is an experimental sector of Svarog Heavy Industries. I, Uranus, am of Svarog birth, and am familiar with their construction methods and schemes.
units.displayText: Helios is an experimental sector of Svarog Heavy Industries. I, Uranus, am of Svarog birth, and am familiar with their construction methods and schemes.

spans.text: Helios is an experimental sector of Svarog Heavy Industries. I, Uranus, am of Svarog birth, and am familiar with their construction methods and schemes.

units.rawText: I wish to aid them in their efforts, Commander.
units.displayText: I wish to aid them in their efforts, Commander.

spans.text: I wish to aid them in their efforts, Commander.

units.rawText: Aside from that, there's also the matter of swapping out the memristor...
units.displayText: Aside from that, there's also the matter of swapping out the memristor...

spans.text: Aside from that, there's also the matter of swapping out the memristor...

units.rawText: Zzp—such matters are inconsequential in comparison to assisting Helios. If it can be located, I would be overjoyed, but I would have no regrets if the opposite is true.
units.displayText: Zzp—such matters are inconsequential in comparison to assisting Helios. If it can be located, I would be overjoyed, but I would have no regrets if the opposite is true.

spans.text: Zzp—such matters are inconsequential in comparison to assisting Helios. If it can be located, I would be overjoyed, but I would have no regrets if the opposite is true.

units.rawText: Memristor? Units within neural modules responsible for storing memories?
units.displayText: Memristor? Units within neural modules responsible for storing memories?

spans.text: Memristor? Units within neural modules responsible for storing memories?

units.rawText: I recall that your Neural Cloud is an assemblage of C-Doll Neural Clouds. Are those modules malfunctioning?
units.displayText: I recall that your Neural Cloud is an assemblage of C-Doll Neural Clouds. Are those modules malfunctioning?

spans.text: I recall that your Neural Cloud is an assemblage of C-Doll Neural Clouds. Are those modules malfunctioning?

units.rawText: They only cause minor detriments, Commander.
units.displayText: They only cause minor detriments, Commander.

spans.text: They only cause minor detriments, Commander.

units.rawText: What do you mean "minor detriments"... let me explain.
units.displayText: What do you mean "minor detriments"... let me explain.

spans.text: What do you mean "minor detriments"... let me explain.

units.rawText: Uranus' current relatively simple civilian Neural Cloud can somewhat keep up with everyone, but the resources it demands in operation put intense stress on his neural modules.
units.displayText: Uranus' current relatively simple civilian Neural Cloud can somewhat keep up with everyone, but the resources it demands in operation put intense stress on his neural modules.

spans.text: Uranus' current relatively simple civilian Neural Cloud can somewhat keep up with everyone, but the resources it demands in operation put intense stress on his neural modules.

units.rawText: If we leave it as is, Uranus' body may cease to function properly soon.
units.displayText: If we leave it as is, Uranus' body may cease to function properly soon.

spans.text: If we leave it as is, Uranus' body may cease to function properly soon.

units.rawText: De Lacey had advised me to exchange my memristor for Svarog Heavy Industries' MR1207 to increase neural processing upper limit, and reduce the impact of high-frequency computation on my neural cloud.
units.displayText: De Lacey had advised me to exchange my memristor for Svarog Heavy Industries' MR1207 to increase neural processing upper limit, and reduce the impact of high-frequency computation on my neural cloud.

spans.text: De Lacey had advised me to exchange my memristor for Svarog Heavy Industries' MR1207 to increase neural processing upper limit, and reduce the impact of high-frequency computation on my neural cloud.

units.rawText: I will find time to exchange my memristor in the process of assisting Helios. I would ask you to not worry.
units.displayText: I will find time to exchange my memristor in the process of assisting Helios. I would ask you to not worry.

spans.text: I will find time to exchange my memristor in the process of assisting Helios. I would ask you to not worry.

units.rawText: So that's what it was...
units.displayText: So that's what it was...

spans.text: So that's what it was...

units.rawText: I mull over it a little, looking at Penumbra, still silent.
units.displayText: I mull over it a little, looking at Penumbra, still silent.

spans.text: I mull over it a little, looking at Penumbra, still silent.

units.rawText: Penumbra, you interested?
units.displayText: Penumbra, you interested?

spans.text: Penumbra, you interested?

units.rawText: You mean assisting Helios in rebuilding?
units.displayText: You mean assisting Helios in rebuilding?

spans.text: You mean assisting Helios in rebuilding?

units.rawText: Yes, as well as finding a suitable replacement part for Uranus.
units.displayText: Yes, as well as finding a suitable replacement part for Uranus.

spans.text: Yes, as well as finding a suitable replacement part for Uranus.

units.rawText: Penumbra has a wealth of combat experience, and also comes from Svarog. If he could accompany Uranus, that would be a most perfect arrangement.
units.displayText: Penumbra has a wealth of combat experience, and also comes from Svarog. If he could accompany Uranus, that would be a most perfect arrangement.

spans.text: Penumbra has a wealth of combat experience, and also comes from Svarog. If he could accompany Uranus, that would be a most perfect arrangement.

units.rawText: If those are the Professor's orders, I will make every effort.
units.displayText: If those are the Professor's orders, I will make every effort.

spans.text: If those are the Professor's orders, I will make every effort.

units.rawText: This isn't an order.
units.displayText: This isn't an order.

spans.text: This isn't an order.

units.rawText: Not an order?
units.displayText: Not an order?

spans.text: Not an order?

units.rawText: Correct. Please see it as a part of the progress to finding your meaning in existence. I hope that you can find your very own future in Helios.
units.displayText: Correct. Please see it as a part of the progress to finding your meaning in existence. I hope that you can find your very own future in Helios.

spans.text: Correct. Please see it as a part of the progress to finding your meaning in existence. I hope that you can find your very own future in Helios.

units.rawText: ...I understand.
units.displayText: ...I understand.

spans.text: ...I understand.

units.rawText: Of course, your safety is above all else. If any circumstances arise, contact the Oasis immediately. That is an order.
units.displayText: Of course, your safety is above all else. If any circumstances arise, contact the Oasis immediately. That is an order.

spans.text: Of course, your safety is above all else. If any circumstances arise, contact the Oasis immediately. That is an order.

units.rawText: Order received. Thank you, Commander.
units.displayText: Order received. Thank you, Commander.

spans.text: Order received. Thank you, Commander.

units.rawText: Penumbra nods somewhat awkwardly, following Uranus. Before he had even taken a dozen steps, he seems to remember something, turning around.
units.displayText: Penumbra nods somewhat awkwardly, following Uranus. Before he had even taken a dozen steps, he seems to remember something, turning around.

spans.text: Penumbra nods somewhat awkwardly, following Uranus. Before he had even taken a dozen steps, he seems to remember something, turning around.

units.rawText: Professor.
units.displayText: Professor.

spans.text: Professor.

units.rawText: Yes? Anything else you would like? Maybe some backing from the Oasis, or...
units.displayText: Yes? Anything else you would like? Maybe some backing from the Oasis, or...

spans.text: Yes? Anything else you would like? Maybe some backing from the Oasis, or...

units.rawText: Before I return, I would urge you to be cautious of everyone around you. Do not drink any coffee given to you by strangers.
units.displayText: Before I return, I would urge you to be cautious of everyone around you. Do not drink any coffee given to you by strangers.

spans.text: Before I return, I would urge you to be cautious of everyone around you. Do not drink any coffee given to you by strangers.

units.rawText: The Sanctifiers may be our allies, but we cannot guarantee that their intentions are pure. Be especially aware of that Sanctifier close to you.
units.displayText: The Sanctifiers may be our allies, but we cannot guarantee that their intentions are pure. Be especially aware of that Sanctifier close to you.

spans.text: The Sanctifiers may be our allies, but we cannot guarantee that their intentions are pure. Be especially aware of that Sanctifier close to you.

units.rawText: I pray that you keep yourself safe before I, Penumbra, returns. Contact me the moment you feel threatened.
units.displayText: I pray that you keep yourself safe before I, Penumbra, returns. Contact me the moment you feel threatened.

spans.text: I pray that you keep yourself safe before I, Penumbra, returns. Contact me the moment you feel threatened.

units.rawText: It's getting late. You two ought to rest and prepare.
units.displayText: It's getting late. You two ought to rest and prepare.

spans.text: It's getting late. You two ought to rest and prepare.

units.rawText: Shall I prepare one last meal for you before I leave?
units.displayText: Shall I prepare one last meal for you before I leave?

spans.text: Shall I prepare one last meal for you before I leave?

units.rawText: T-That won't be necessary...
units.displayText: T-That won't be necessary...
